source.rationale: Every walk over the resolver payload is null-guarded because the CRM has been seen to emit sparse arrays. A null resolution, a null match and a null intersection row must all be skipped rather than dereferenced — the mutation that turns any of those guards into its opposite throws and takes the whole turn down, which on this lane means the customer gets nothing at all. The turn still reaches the correct disjoint verdict.

The raw slug is unchanged wherever it is routed on or persisted.
